svg.text: From GT raw materials to a loaded gun
Ammo is the highest-volume consumable, so it is the one place GregGuns adds its own machine and recipe map (gregguns.ammoPress). Everything upstream is plain GregTech.
Single block, animated ram and belt
Multiblock: feeder, press bays, packing station
Voltage = the ammo's tier. Not in the Assembler map.
Three real recipes (docs/gregguns-spec/06-items/recipes.md: RC-28, RC-37, RC-44)
Fuel, bio and air tanks: Assembler + Fluid Canner.
